title: Personalized Baseball Bedding Full Size Flag Custom Name D - Design 17
description:
Score a home run with your bedroom decor with the Jeminise Personalized Baseball Comforter Set. This cozy and durable bedding set is perfect for baseball players, fans, and lovers, designed to celebrate determination and passion for the sport. Customize it with a name to make it truly yours or gift it to a special someone.

Key Features

  • Meaningful Gift: An ideal gift for men, women, moms, dads, or any baseball enthusiast for Valentine's, Mother's, Father's Day, or Christmas.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88") to fit various bed sizes.
  • Superior Manufacturing: Features an environmental protection finishing process to hold dye and prevent fading, ensuring long-lasting vibrancy.
  • Soft & Comfy Material: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric with whole-piece microfiber filling for a soft, durable, and lightweight feel.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water; air dry without heat. Microfiber dries quickly and fluffs up nicely.
  • Personalized Design: Features a rustic baseball and gloves design, with options for 2 text inputs for customization.
  • Included Components: This set includes a duvet cover, perfect for refreshing your bedding.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter Set
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester, Cotton
Fill Material Microfiber
Color Baseball Thunder
Pattern Baseball
Set Name Personalized Baseball Bedding Set
Customization 2 text inputs
Available Sizes US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), US King (104" x 88")

Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
